conservation.condition_narrative:
- Paper is heavily cockled and wrinkled. 
- Brown inclusion on left. 
- Thicker areas of paint have network cracking but are stable. 
- Slightly darked areas on left and right edges that appear to be grime. 
- There are scattered slightly brown inclusions scattered throughout the paper 
Frame is in very good condition with a minor scratch near the center of the top rail.
conservation.report_notes: Information provided for *Access O'Keeffe* by Brooklyn Museum of Art in 2025.

cr_data.provenance: Until 1958 Downtown Gallery (The), New York, N.Y., then Purchased by Brooklyn Museum (The) (Source: Brooklyn Museum of Art, 2025)
remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive. Abiquiú Notebooks indicates lost inscription, "Back: O'K: 'No. 3'" [No. 3 is Downtown Gallery inventory number.] Abiquiú Notebooks after 1977 indicates, "Sold by Halpert, April 1958." Completed in Virginia before August move to Texas. See cat. nos. 91, 92, 94. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: Two blue, semicircular forms arch one over the other. Strips of blue paint run diagonally over the lower right corner of the composition. The shapes sit against plain, exposed white paper.
